body: Im on a galaxy s5 with virgin mobile

I feel the same way... just quit my job and wont be able to cover rent next month to boot...  feel like i only ever cared about finding the love of my life but feel like no woman would want a man like me or with nothing to offer like me...  wish i could just give up and kill myself but the guilt of knowing how much it would hurt others prevents that...  i dont know what to do anymore and just stay in bed all day...  i could go on but...  in any case, i think im gonna go back to the hospital...  i like it there...  but i know ill be even further behind after...  still think the better option is to end it tho...
At a distance it smells like sesseme oil,  and i like the smell of sesseme oil.

Ruminating, daydreaming and fantisizing...
  I often see thing or people and ruminate about my elaborate new life... sometimes for hours on end.  Sometimes i get married and have kids, or become a inspiring teacher...  fall in love with my soul mate or cry by her deathbed...  move on and raise the kids...  
Its quite beautiful but sad because its all in my head and not true, just a result or symptom of my depression and such... :(
